actions.title: Set up an application
actions.summary: Open Applications and select the exact component.
actions.prerequisites: A compatible trusted package and explicit approval for installation or update.
actions.effects: Setup changes installed software only after review.
actions.confirmation: Approve the exact application, version and install or update in Suite Manager.

example.request: Set up the example Train application.
example.result: Manager shows the selected component and version for approval.

actions.recovery: Keep the original workflow available. Use Manager retry, repair or rollback as offered.

actions.title: Create a training collection
actions.summary: In Dataset, choose Manage Collections and create a named collection. Add images separately when ready.
actions.prerequisites: A writable Organizer library. Creating and filling a collection does not require Train.
actions.effects: Saving creates a collection record. It does not add images, export a package or start training.
actions.confirmation: Save the named collection, then explicitly choose any images to add in Dataset.

example.request: Create a collection named Example Landscapes.
example.result: Organizer saves Example Landscapes and shows zero images until members are added.

actions.recovery: Reopen Manage Collections and select the saved collection before adding members or preparing an export.

actions.title: Export a training collection
actions.summary: Open Dataset, review the selected collection version, and choose export.
actions.prerequisites: A reviewed collection and writable user-selected destination.
actions.effects: Export writes a separate artifact after review. The source collection stays available.
actions.confirmation: Approve the selected collection version and destination before exporting.

example.request: Export version 2 of Example Landscapes for training.
example.result: Organizer records an export receipt for version 2 and keeps the source collection.

actions.recovery: Review changed collection evidence, destination conflicts or missing files and retry only the failed step.

actions.title: Remix an image
actions.summary: Select an eligible image and choose Remix This Image.
actions.prerequisites: An unchanged source and a compatible Generate installation for the handoff.
actions.effects: Opening a draft carries the source into Generate. Submission is a separate decision.
actions.confirmation: Review the selected source at handoff and approve any generation separately.

example.result: Generate opens a reviewable draft with the sample landscape as its source.

actions.recovery: If Generate is missing, review setup in Manager. Reconnect the exact image after restart or select a changed source explicitly.

actions.title: Look up a reference tag
actions.summary: Search the available reference content and inspect the full category path.
actions.prerequisites: Tag Encyclopedia and the relevant optional reference content.
actions.effects: Lookup is read-only. Corrections to image knowledge are reviewed in Organizer.
actions.confirmation: Lookup needs no write approval. Approve any proposed image knowledge correction in Organizer.

example.request: Find the category path for the example landscape tag.
example.result: Encyclopedia displays the matching tag and its category for review.

actions.recovery: Use Manager for missing content, or return to the previous search or Organizer selection.

actions.title: Review and submit an image remix
actions.summary: Review the source, engine, settings and required models before generating.
actions.prerequisites: Compatible resources and an admitted runtime for the exact recipe.
actions.effects: Save the draft separately. Submitting runs a job after user confirmation and result intake is reviewed in Organizer.
actions.confirmation: Approve the reviewed recipe before submission and review result intake separately.

example.request: Review a remix of the sample landscape with the example recipe.
example.result: Generate shows the draft, recipe and resource requirements before submission.

actions.recovery: Preserve the draft on failure and check the existing job status before retrying an uncertain submission.

actions.title: Review a training package
actions.summary: Open the selected package and review its dataset, method and resources.
actions.prerequisites: An admitted package and compatible resources for the requested method.
actions.effects: Package review precedes a separate user decision to prepare or start training.
actions.confirmation: Review the package first and approve preparation or run start at its explicit decision.

example.request: Review the Example Landscapes training package.
example.result: Train shows the dataset, intended method and missing resources before preparation.

actions.recovery: Review incompatibilities or reopen the exact saved preparation after interruption.
